data.name: Witch's Bane
data.description: Any creature that casts an arcane spell within 30 feet of the witch hunter takes a -2 penalty to AC against her attacks and a -2 penalty on saving throws against her spells while this judgment remains in effect. This ability replaces exploit weakness.
